competences.description: Performs an unpredictable attack and decreases the target's Attack Power for 1 turn. This attack will also increase the target's chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 1 turn if this attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times with waves of water. Each hit decreases their Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance. If the enemy is already granted with Decrease Attack Speed, stuns for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: If already has Reduce SPD debuff

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 4 times. Each hit has a 35% chance to remove 1 beneficial effect and decrease its Defense for 2 turns. Afterwards, increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 10%.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
